scenarios.name: Standard Earthquake Evacuation
scenarios.description: A 5.8 magnitude earthquake strikes while you are on the 2nd floor of a public library during afternoon hours. About 30 visitors and 5 staff members are present. The building is a modern concrete structure with two stairwells and one elevator.

narrative_details.location: Central Public Library, 2nd floor reading area
narrative_details.people_nearby: Several visitors reading, a librarian at the desk, children in the story corner
narrative_details.environment: Books are falling from shelves, ceiling lights are swaying, people are screaming

scenarios.name: Earthquake with Injured Persons
scenarios.description: A 6.2 magnitude earthquake hits while you are on the 3rd floor of a community center during a public event. Approximately 80 people are present. After the shaking stops, you discover an elderly person has been struck by a falling shelf and a child is crying with a minor cut.

narrative_details.location: Riverside Community Center, 3rd floor event hall
narrative_details.people_nearby: Event attendees in formal clothing, catering staff, elderly guests, families with children
narrative_details.environment: Decorations have fallen, tables overturned, glass from a window has shattered, lights flickering

scenarios.name: Earthquake with Blocked Primary Route
scenarios.description: A 6.5 magnitude earthquake strikes while you are on the 4th floor of a government office building. The main stairwell has been partially blocked by a collapsed ceiling section. Smoke is detected coming from the basement level.

narrative_details.location: Municipal Government Services Building, 4th floor offices
narrative_details.people_nearby: Office workers, visitors waiting in queue, security guard, mail clerk
narrative_details.environment: Ceiling tiles have fallen, a section of the hallway ceiling has collapsed near the main stairwell, acrid smell of smoke from below, fire alarm is sounding, sprinklers are partially active
